observables.derivation: Aggregate HP states for ships in currently visible deck ports; do not retain ship identities.

limitations: Escaped or otherwise unavailable ships must remain unknown instead of healthy.

observables.derivation: Compare each visible deck ship's fuel and ammunition with its master maximum.

observables.derivation: Count unlocked repair docks by state and summarize occupied completion times without ship identity.

observables.derivation: Count unlocked ships and visible modernization yields, but never infer that a ship is safe to consume.

observables.derivation: Read the unlocked deck count, with visible deck ports as a consistency check.

observables.derivation: Intersect visible quest IDs with locally curated prerequisite relationships; never invent hidden prerequisites.

observables.unknownFallback: Show only currently visible unlock quests and label the chain incomplete.

observables.derivation: List mission IDs returned in the existing member mission state.

observables.derivation: No existing state provides a trustworthy count of remaining practice opponents for the current refresh window.

observables.derivation: Aggregate owned ship levels into anonymous configured bands.

observables.derivation: Collect in-progress quest IDs from the existing live or cached quest list.

observables.derivation: Treat map IDs present in member map info as unlocked and map them through master map data.
